projects.title: #KANOs4Kakindu
projects.tagline: The club's flagship project: adopting a whole community in Kakindu, Mityana, across Rotary's areas of focus.
projects.summary: Since 2020 the club has worked with Malwa Umea Primary School and the Kakindu community in Mityana District: renovating and building classroom blocks, stocking a library, harvesting rainwater, fighting malaria, running medical camps, planting trees and supporting girls and boys to stay in school.
projects.locationName: Malwa Umea Primary School, Kakindu, Mityana District
projects.beneficiaries: Pupils and teachers of Malwa Umea Primary School and the Kakindu community
projects.need: Malwa Umea is a Universal Primary Education school in Kakindu, Mityana District. When the club's technical team assessed it in October 2020, its classroom blocks were old and run down. The club later named the needs it set out to meet: decent classrooms, books and a library, clean water, protection from malaria, health care, and support for girls and boys to stay in school.
projects.idea: Adopt one community and address several of Rotary's areas of focus in one place, phase by phase. The club calls it its signature project, "where we adopted an entire community to address Rotary 7 areas of focus" (Carolyne Bavuga, Aug 2024). The club's link with Kakindu goes back to a medical camp it held there in April 2016.
projects.beginning: Members Pascal Ongom and a fellow member drew the technical drawings. The club raised money with the Jungle Rumble fundraiser (Nov 2020) and project days, and in March 2021 members renovated the first three-classroom block: re-screeding floors, refurbishing walls and splash aprons, replacing wooden openings with metal ones, painting blackboards and adding rainwater harvesting.
projects.impact: Phase I was handed over on 25 September 2021, the same day the club launched #KANOsAgainstMalaria. Since then: 400 mosquito nets (Nov 2021), a 10,000-litre water tank (Mar 2022), a library stocked with over 1,000 books from Enjuba and launched by DG Mike Sebalu (Nov 2022), exam support for candidates (Oct 2023), a multipurpose hall under construction and the C2F malaria programme (Mar 2024), and a newly built classroom block handed over with the launch of the Girl Child Initiative (Sept 2025).
projects.today: The club is completing the multipurpose building at Malwa Umea Primary School and plans youth skilling and stronger community health programmes (club thread, March 2025). It announced a US$35,000 global grant with the Rotary Club of Madras (D3234) for digital literacy in three schools under BELEP (Nov 2024). In September 2026 the project reached Kiyoganyi Health Centre III in Mityana North, where a new solar system was commissioned.

projects.title: United Against Malaria
projects.tagline: Medical camps, mosquito nets and net-use training in Mityana North.
projects.summary: A malaria project in Mityana North that grew out of #KANOsAgainstMalaria, run with Malaria Partners Uganda, Malaria Partners International and Pilgrim Africa.
projects.need: Malaria remains one of the biggest health threats in Mityana. The club's malaria work began in Kakindu in 2021 with mass testing, treatment and 400 nets.
projects.beginning: The project was launched on 9 August 2025 with its first phase in Mityana North, in partnership with Malaria Partners Uganda, Malaria Partners International, Pilgrim Africa, Rotaract Bwebajja and the Rotary Club of Kampala North.
projects.impact: Over 500 community members attended the first medical camp and received free blood tests, treatment, counselling and mosquito nets. Members trained families on how to use nets properly.
projects.today: In March 2026 the club returned to Mityana for a second phase with fumigation suits, treated nets and mama kits.

projects.title: Little Miracles, Big Impact
projects.tagline: A child immunisation drive that moves from community to community in Kampala.
projects.summary: A phased immunisation drive bringing vaccines, health education, blood pressure screening and family planning consultations closer to families in Kampala's communities.
projects.need: Many families find it hard to reach routine immunisation. The drive takes vaccines to where they live.
projects.beginning: Phase 1 was held at Butabika Hospital Village on 29 November 2025, led by Chief Immuniser Dr. Dennis Okwir.
projects.impact: Phase 2 at Butabika Sports Arena (February 2026) added health education for caregivers. Phase 3 in Namuwongo B Village (21 March 2026), with the Rotaract clubs of Bunga and Mildmay, offered immunisation, blood pressure screening and family planning consultations in one place.
projects.today: Phase 4 was announced for Kinawataka (May 2026). "More phases ahead."

posts.text: All roads have been cleaned just for All star President @ssekalio gets installed on 10th June 2016.
#TeamKanos @dorah_kamugisha & Liz @RotaryCancerRun with DG Jayesh H Asher #RotaryCR16
#KanosNewsletter @Rotary My Family by our Club CEO @dnsalma
Our Vice President @Younisebz handed over the #RotaractImage club Award received during #DCA92 in Arusha Tanzania to @rctuict President
We introduce to you the new President. MGP @ShanTushabe. We wish you the best and a lovely #Rotary18.
Congratulations to our Inspirational President @Rctbright. Our President on Saturday went on one knee to propose to his love of life Berna Bethany. We wish them all the best.
The long awaited #KANOsHospitality powered by Buddy Group Galilee headed by @RoyBecky has been approved. You're all invited to bond with us.
@kanosug partnering with @PGUganda to save lives in Uganda. We are delighted to be joined by members from @RCkigalicity. #GiveBloodSaveLife #KnowYourStatus #WorldAIDSDay #PG4Youth
Congratulations to us from on wards and upwards. A million thanks to all club members and guests that have blessed us with your presence today evening. #KANOsAT4
Do zoom in this Friday as we witness the Installation of our esteemed 6th President @AlexNiyonzima at 14:00 EAT. Our Guest of honor shall be @Comrade_Otoa #6thKANOsInstallation

ADOPT-KAKINDU PROJECT. KANOs Technical team today visited Malwa Umea Primary School as part of the project assessment, thanks to @AlexNiyonzima @SanSaWajja @AggieNims @pascalongom @Nankya5 @vicentkatungi for the work done #KANOS4KAKINDU
One day to go! The Jungle Rumble early bird registration will be closing in the next few hours. Secure your #JungleRF20 ticket now. Join us as we raise funds for the #KANOs4Kakindu project in style.

A sneak peek at the three classroom block that has undergone floor re-screeding, refurbishment of the splash aprons, interior and exterior wall surfaces. Works happening include replacement of all wooden openings to metal, addition of a water harvesting system #KANOs4Kakindu
Each child with a book to aid in learning shall better the education standards of these kids. Thank you to all that donated money to buy books. #KANOs4Kakindu
We planted fruit trees around the school so that in future the school going pupils can have a bite but also as a remembrance for KANOs. We shall plant the trees wherever we shall go. #KANOs4Kakindu
A lot of thanks to the KANOs team that represented us at the Kakindu Community Reading day, a big thanks to our partners @enjuba1 who played a major role in making this day a success #KANOs4Kakindu

No more bells ringing. It's done. Nothing can stop us now! Ladies and gentlemen it's our installation date. The event shall be graced by @EmKatongole and Clerk to @Parliament_Ug. #7thKANOsInstallation

The #KANOs4Kakindu project phase one of construction and renovation of classroom block at 80% now. Thank you to all who have supported the cause. We look forward to handing over a fully furnished block by end of September 2021.

The classroom block has been officially handed over to the community and school by the @MovitProductsUg MD. We look forward to partnering in the project extensively. #KANOsAgainstMalaria #KANOs4Kakindu
We as well launched the starting of phase II of the construction project where the old building in Frame 1-3 will be demolished and replaced with frame 4. #KANOs4Kakindu #KANOsAgainstMalaria
400 nets are being distributed to the Kakindu community, a big step in the #KANOsAgainstMalaria project, nets that were sponsored by our partners @RCMuyenga #KANOs4Kakindu

Over the weekend, we commissioned a 10k litre water tank in Kakindu for rain water harvest as a first measure to address the water scarcity challenges. The chief guest was DRR @_Mukasa and Rotarian @chris_kayongo. #KANOs4Kakindu

To address the issue of maternal and child death related issues, we donated sorted items to the community health centre to help in the delivery of mothers. These are to be given out free instead of the 30,000 mothers have been paying to be attended to. #KANOs4Kakindu
We would like to invite you to our biggest event of the year: the 8th KANOs presidential installation that will take place on 7th May 2022, 2pm at Hotel Triangle, Buganda Rd. #The8thKANOsInstallation

Today afternoon our club community service chair @SyliviaKitty was delighted to receive the 1050 books from @enjuba1 towards our #KANOs4Kakindu. We continue to thank Enjuba for the loving heart towards humanity!

Thank you President for hosting us home and giving us a chance to showcase our #KANOs4Kakindu project. We hope to do amazing things with our mother club @rckampalanorth in this amazing #ImagineRotary year. #RotaryKlaNorthMeets

The moment we've all been waiting for! Our amazing DG @mikesebaluken officially launched the school library, where with the help of @enjuba1, stocked the library with over 1000 reading books for pupils! #KANOs4Kakindu

Winding up the #KANOs4Kakindu project with an after project at Forest Park Buloba, to celebrate this milestone where the guest of honor @mikesebaluken has recognized KANOs with a certificate of appreciation for contributions towards @RotaryBelep for D9213 #ImagineRotary

In the 8 years, we have prioritized empowering the young generation under basic education and literacy at our project of #KANOs4Kakindu where we recently handed over a fully stocked library at Malwa Umea P/S which was presided over by our DG @mikesebaluken. We are #KANOsAt8
Ladies and gentlemen, friends and partners, we introduce to you our #9ThKANOsInstallation of our Hopeful President @CarolyneBavuga. Please mark the date & venue: the 20th of May at Protea Hotel!

Members of our club, led by President @CarolyneBavuga visited the candidates of Malwa Umea Primary School, in Kakindu, to wish them success in their exams. They gave each pupil a success card and mathematical set to get them ready for exams. #KANOs4Kakindu #KANOsCreatingHope

Ladies and gentlemen, it is our pleasure to introduce the President Nominee for the Rotary term 2025/26, Mr. @wanelobarogers, also known as Raj. An accomplished accountant and law student, he serves as the managing partner at @Winterdalep.
Ladies and gentlemen, mark your calendars for May 18, 2024: a historic day as we install our 10th President, @EdwinMuyunga. #10thKANOsInstallation
We're also privileged to have our Guest of Honor, @DGKenMugisha, unveil the 3D impression of the multipurpose hall, which is already under construction. #KANOs4Kakindu

Our Guest of Honor has officially launched the C2F program. In his message during the launch, he stressed that the program is aimed at supporting communities through school, emphasizing that the fight against malaria starts with us. #KANOs4Kakindu
Empowering women starts with health and dignity. With support from @PadsQi, we've distributed sanitary towels to women and pupils at Malwa Umea Primary School. #KANOs4Kakindu

We do projects within our communities, we've around 6 projects running concurrently as KANOs. Our signature project as KANOs is #KANOs4Kakindu where we adopted an entire community to address Rotary 7 areas of focus. ~ @CarolyneBavuga #ItsTimeToJoinRotaract

Honored to participate in Malwa UMEA's Speech Day! We're grateful for the school's recognition of our support. We're excited to advance our community project, a $35,000 global grant with Rotary Club Madras (D3234), boosting digital literacy in 3 schools under BELEP #KANOs4Kakindu

#KANOs4Kakindu is our flagship project dedicated to uplifting the Kakindu community in Mityana District. From enhancing education and health to ensuring clean water and fostering peace, we're committed to making a lasting impact.

Future plans: complete the multipurpose building at Malwa UMEA Primary School; launch youth skilling and empowerment programs; enhance community health programs to ensure sustainable well-being. #KANOs4Kakindu
A huge THANK YOU to our incredible partners & sponsors for making #KANOs4Kakindu a success! Your support is transforming lives & empowering communities.

ENGAGEMENT EXCELLENCE! Our club is thrilled to receive the Corporate Membership Engagement Award for the Rotary year 24/25! Thank you to our members and partners for their collaboration and support! #100ThDISCON

On Friday 18th July we were privileged to host the DRR @AbesageN to our club. We started off the visit with a board meeting where we had a wonderful discussion about the club's current state and future plans. #KANOsMeetUp

Health for all. Over 500 community members attended our medical camp, receiving free blood tests, treatment, counselling, and mosquito nets. A healthier community is a stronger community. #UnitedAgainstMalaria #KANOsAgainstMalaria

Huge congratulations to us! We're thrilled to have achieved the prestigious Club Excellence Award for the RY 24/25! This recognition reflects our commitment to fostering a positive experience for our members and upholding the values of Rotary.

On 20th September, the #KANOs4Kakindu project Phase 6 brought hope and impact to Malwa UMEA P/S. We launched the Girl Child Initiative to empower young girls, offered free medical services to the community, planted trees for a greener tomorrow, and handed over a newly built classroom block.
Drumrolls for the newest President on the block! Congratulations Charter President @salimatusaba on your installation and the entire @ekampalanorth. #EKANOsInstallation25 #EKANOsCharter

Our heartfelt gratitude to our Chief Immunizer, Dr. @dennisokwir, for his leadership, professionalism, and commitment to community health. Your guidance and dedication were instrumental in the success of today's immunization drive.

Last Saturday, we didn't just show up. We showed out. Rotaract Kampala North headed to Mityana and we came with fumigation suits, treated nets, mama kits, and a mission. This is what United Against Malaria looks like in action. #UnitedAgainstMalaria

Vaccines. Volunteers. A community that came ready. The Rotaract Club of Kampala North set up stations for immunization, blood pressure screening, and family planning consultations all in one place. This is what service looks like in action.
Thank you to each & everyone that joined us yesterday for our fellowship as our President Elect @19StMunian was unveiling the impact board & officers, see y'all again soon. #KANOsMeetUp

Before we step into the 12th, let's remember the magic of the 11th. The 11th KANOs Presidential Installation was an Arabian Nights theme, Rotaractors dressed to the nines, and a club that showed up in full force.
The 11th was unforgettable. But the 12th? We're just getting started. Same club. Same heart. New chapter. See you at the 12th KANOs Installation of PE @19StMunian #12ThKANOsInstallation
Congratulations to @Nabukeerawinni4 of @LittleWinnieFo2 on receiving the KANOs Vocational Service Award. Your work speaks louder than any award ever could. #KANOsMeetUp
A look back at the visit of our Immediate Past DRR @AbesageN to KANOs #KANOsTBT

It started as a solar commissioning. It became a full day of service. Rotary Kampala Springs + Rotaract Kampala North + Rotaract Bwebajja and E-KANOs at Mboona Kiyoganyi Health Unit, Mityana District #KANOs4Kakindu #CommunityImpact

During the solar commissioning at Kiyoganyi, Immediate Past President @wanelobarogers provided a comprehensive walkthrough of the newly installed system's operational design and purpose. At its core, this project was executed to ensure uninterrupted, critical infrastructure.

Step out with us for an engaging field learning experience where we will discover manufacturing practices, connect with professionals, and broaden our career horizons in Mbale. Mark your calendars for Friday afternoon on October 9th! #KANOsRetreat

Join us for an engaging conversation on "Making It in Uganda Today: Youth, Opportunity and the Economics of Survival" featuring Fatir Muzaaya. Friday, 2 October 2026, 6:00 PM, Hotel Triangle, Kampala.

Congratulations to you @KiraboJael72957 on being recognized as the guest of the month of September. Your commitment and consistency in participating in club activities and meetings have truly stood out.
